install.cli: --apply always exits 78 before any filesystem operation
install.postcondition: one new retained version; no active selector or enabled profile

update.transaction: separate reviewed pin and version constant; same exclusive publication transaction

drain.current_action: none: Darwin profile admission already disabled
drain.future_action: close new native admissions under daemon registry mutex; invalidate pending native delivery; allow owned children to exit or use existing launch-fenced ExecutorClose; wait/join their PTY cleanup

uninstall.transaction: disable native admission in a separately approved backend revision; drain owned sessions; retain every published inode and manifest indefinitely
uninstall.physical_purge: unsupported online; requires a distinct offline maintenance design and explicit authorization

rollback.before_publication: retain failed root-only .stage-* for explicit review; no error-path recursive removal
rollback.after_publication: leave new and previous versions retained and disabled; current code requires no selector change
rollback.future_enabled_backend: disable new admissions and drain first; reselect an independently approved retained version only in a separately reviewed backend revision
